source: Cyberpunk RED Core Rulebook, pg. 144-162 (Role Abilities)

general_rules.rank_up_cost: IP-based, see ip_cost_by_next_rank in items.json Role Ability Upgrades

rockerboy.summary: Influence fans through sheer presence of personality. Works on Fans only.

1-2.single: Small favor: buy drink/meal, give lift
1-2.group: Up to 6 fans: autographs, befriend in streets

3-4.single: Major favor: go to bed, put in a good word
3-4.huge: Strong local following, fans buy merch

5-6.single: Minor crime: shoplift, help in fight
5-6.huge: Citywide fans, strongly loyal, major favors

7-8.venues: Small concert halls, local video feed
7-8.huge: Rabidly loyal, fight rivals, info networks

9.venues: Large concert halls, national video feed
9.single: Major crime: steal expensive item, beat someone up

solo.summary: Divide Rank points among combat abilities. Can re-divide outside combat, before initiative, or with an Action in combat.

damage_deflection.description: Decrease the first damage you take this Round

fumble_recovery.description: Ignore critical failures (1s) when attacking (still treated as 1)

initiative_reaction.description: +1 to Initiative rolls per point spent

spot_weakness.description: Adds bonus damage (before armor) to first successful Attack in Round

threat_detection.description: Enhanced situational awareness, +1 to Perception Checks

netrunner.summary: Allows Netrunning. Determines NET Actions per Turn and grants Interface Abilities.

interface_abilities.backdoor: Break through Passwords and other obstructions in the Architecture
interface_abilities.cloak: Hide actions in the Architecture before leaving
interface_abilities.control: Control things attached to the Architecture
interface_abilities.eye_dee: Identify found data and its value
interface_abilities.scanner: Find locations of systems in an area
interface_abilities.slide: Slip away from one Black ICE following you
interface_abilities.virus: Leave a custom virus at the Architecture's core
interface_abilities.zap: Basic Netrunner attack vs Programs and other Netrunners

tech.summary: Fix, improve, modify, make, and invent items. Each Rank +1 gives 1 Rank in 2 different Maker Specialties.

field_expertise.description: Add Rank to Basic Tech/Cybertech/Electronics-Security/Weaponstech/Land-Sea-Air Vehicle Tech Checks (Non-Maker purposes)
field_expertise.extra: Can jury-rig items: 10 minutes per Rank to perfect condition, item degrades back after

upgrade_expertise.description: Upgrade items (1 upgrade per item from this specialty)
options: Lower Humanity Loss of non-borgware cyberware by 1d6 if HL ≥ 2d6
Halve full repair time for the item
Upgrade Average to Excellent Quality Weapon
Grant Attachment Slot to an Exotic Weapon
Allow Exotic Weapon to fire one variety of Non-Basic Ammo
Increase item's SP by 1 (if it had any)
upgrade_expertise.formula: TECH + relevant Tech Skill + Specialty Rank + 1d10

fabrication_expertise.description: Fabricate existing or invented items from materials
fabrication_expertise.formula: TECH + relevant Tech Skill + Specialty Rank + 1d10
fabrication_expertise.material_cost: 1 price category lower than fabricated item (except Super Luxury: half price)

invention_expertise.description: Invent new items or upgrades (GM-mediated, results in custom item)

medtech.summary: Per Rank: allocate 1 point to one of 3 Specialties (Surgery, Pharmaceuticals, Cryosystems).

surgery.description: Every point = +2 Surgery Skill (max 10). Treats severe Critical Injuries, implants/harvests cyberware.

pharmaceuticals.description: Every point = +1 Medical Tech Skill (max 5 points). Each point unlocks one Pharmaceutical.
pharmaceuticals.synthesize_yield: 200eb materials → doses equal to Medical Tech Skill, in 1 hour

cryosystem_operation.description: Every point = +1 Medical Tech Skill (max 5 points). Cryotank benefits.

benefits.2: Registered Cryotank Technician, 24/7 access to 1 Cryotank

pharmaceuticals_list.name: Antibiotic
pharmaceuticals_list.effect: Already-healing target heals extra 2 HP/day for 1 week. Once at a time.

pharmaceuticals_list.name: Speedheal
pharmaceuticals_list.effect: Non-Mortally-Wounded target heals BODY + WILL HP instantly. Once per day.

pharmaceuticals_list.name: Stim
pharmaceuticals_list.effect: Ignore all Seriously Wounded penalties for 1 hour. Once per day.

pharmaceuticals_list.name: Surge
pharmaceuticals_list.effect: Function without sleep for 24 hours. Once per week.

medtech.non_medtech_warning: Non-Medtechs cannot administer pharmaceuticals correctly. Requires training.

media.summary: Influence audiences, access sources, pick up rumors passively.
media.passive_rumor_frequency: GM rolls Credibility Rank + 1d10 twice per week

1-2.access: Local honcho, gang lord, neighborhood leadership
1-2.impact: Small-time bad guys may change ways

3-4.access: City gang honcho, minor politician, Corp Exec

5-6.access: Major City player, City politico, local celebrity
5-6.impact: Citywide change, higher-level bad guys jailed, laws passed

7-8.access: Local Corp president, mayor, City celebrity

9.access: Divisional Corp head, State politico, well known celebrity

10.access: Major world leader, major Corp head, world-famous celebrity
10.impact: Global change, Megacorps fall, international laws

story_bonuses.luck: Cannot spend LUCK on Believability Checks

exec.summary: Build a team of corporate-provided members. Get corporate benefits.

benefits_by_rank.1: Signing Bonus: Businesswear suit (Jacket/Top/Bottom/Footwear) — cannot resell
benefits_by_rank.6: Trauma Team Silver coverage (paid by corp)
benefits_by_rank.7: Upgraded housing: Beaverville House in Executive Zone
benefits_by_rank.10: Beaverville McMansion OR Luxury Corporate Zone Penthouse

constraints: Built like PCs but do not improve Skills
Determine and heal HP like PCs
Cannot wear Armor heavier than Light Armorjack (Company Policy)
GM controls them, Loyalty determines if they obey

loyalty.loyalty_save: GM rolls 1d6 vs current Loyalty when task given
loyalty.below_zero: Will actively betray Exec to enemies

team_members.losing_member: Replaced next session, new Loyalty = 1, costs Exec 200eb bribes to HR

lawman.summary: Call fellow law enforcers based on Rank.

call_check.formula: Roll d10, must roll ≤ Backup Rank
call_check.abuse_penalty: Boss throws off force or fines
call_check.lucky_roll: On 1d6=6, next-higher tier backup arrives (Rank 10: two groups)

8.name: Recovery Zone Marshal
8.weapons: Very Heavy Pistol, Assault Rifle, Grenade Launcher

10.name: National Law Enforcement/Interpol/FBI/Netwatch
10.special: Stick around to investigate, same team responds to follow-up calls. Combat Number applies to many skills (Accounting, Acting, Conceal/Reveal, Criminology, Cryptography, Deduction, Education, Forgery, Interrogation, Paramedic, Perception, Personal Grooming, Resist Torture/Drugs, Stealth, Tracking)

fixer.haggle_formula: COOL + Trading Skill + Operator Rank + 1d10 vs opposed Check

1-2.contacts: Local honcho, gang lord, neighborhood leadership
1-2.grease: Local neighborhood cultures + all local gangs

3-4.contacts: City gang honcho, minor politician, Corp Exec
3-4.haggle: Buy 5+ of same item, get 1 free

5-6.contacts: Major City player, City politico, neighborhood celebrity
5-6.reach: Set up Night Market 1x/month with other Fixers → access Super Luxury items
5-6.grease: +2 cultures (3 total), +1 language each at Skill 4

7-8.contacts: Local Corp president, mayor, local celebrity
7-8.reach: Up to Very Expensive items, piece-by-piece
7-8.haggle: Luxury/Super Luxury: pay half now, half in 1 month (default = blacklist)

9.contacts: Divisional Corp head, state/zone politico, well-known celebrity
9.reach: Up to Luxury piece-by-piece. Night Market can include Midnight Market (criminal underworld leadership)

10.contacts: Major world leader, major Corp head, world-famous celebrity
10.haggle: Double pay per person on Dangerous Jobs
10.grease: Almost any group including secret societies, cults, exclusive memberships

nomad.summary: Add Moto Rank to all vehicle Drive/Pilot/Tech Checks. Family Motorpool access.
nomad.vehicle_skill_bonus: Moto Rank adds to Drive Land/Pilot Air/Pilot Sea Vehicle, Air/Land/Sea Vehicle Tech
nomad.per_rank_choice: Either: add stock vehicle (≤ Rank) to Family Pool OR upgrade one Family Vehicle (≤ Rank)

vehicle_constraints.one_at_a_time: Only one Family Vehicle out at a time (swap takes a day)
vehicle_constraints.repair_cost: Destroyed vehicle: Family repairs in 1 week for 500eb (even Family Heads pay)

rank_10_promotion.title: Family Leadership Position
perks: Future Family Vehicles at market price

nomad.vehicle_upgrades_note: Found in shop items.json under 'Vehicle Upgrade'. Most at Very Expensive (Rank 1) or Luxury (higher Ranks).
